meta.scope: One coarse grid reference, not farm-level measurements or mountain microclimates.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.thai: ถั่วเหลือง
crops.notes: Choose a variety suited to local day length. Check that water can drain away.

crops.name: Groundnut
crops.notes: Needs well-drained ground. Avoid fields where water collects.

crops.name: Maize
crops.thai: ข้าวโพดเลี้ยงสัตว์
crops.notes: Keep a water backup for flowering. This guide is for grain maize, not sweet corn.

crops.name: Strawberry
crops.thai: สตรอว์เบอร์รี
crops.notes: Needs mild weather; FAO notes tropical production succeeds above 1,000 m. This reference weather point is lower. Check your exact farm elevation, variety, chilling needs, drainage, and irrigation. The water guide is a rough duration-scaled annual range, not a local field recommendation.

crops.name: Arabica coffee
crops.thai: กาแฟอาราบิก้า
crops.notes: A long-term tree crop, not a one-season harvest. Site, variety, shade, soil, water through establishment, flowering, and processing access matter. FAO guidance prefers elevations above 1,000 m; this reference point is lower. The water guide is a rough duration-scaled annual range, not a local field recommendation.

analog.claim: Retrieves similar historical growing seasons. Not validated as a seasonal forecast or crop-outcome predictor.
